subject.title: Feature: per-channel announce suppression for sub-agents

question: What public policy surface should OpenClaw expose for sub-agent completion announcement suppression and routing?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but choosing between global suppression, per-channel suppression, per-spawn routing, and hook/plugin semantics changes public config/tool contracts and upgrade expectations.

options.title: Default-compatible delivery policy
options.body: Add a canonical completion delivery policy with current behavior as the default, plus channel and optional per-spawn controls for suppress/internal/route-to-parent behavior.

options.title: Narrow suppression only
options.body: Add only a global or per-channel suppression knob now and leave parent routing or hooks to the related follow-up issues.

options.title: Defer core API
options.body: Keep the issue open but avoid new core config until maintainers settle the broader subagent delivery contract across related reports.

recommendation.title: Default-compatible delivery policy
recommendation.body: Add a canonical completion delivery policy with current behavior as the default, plus channel and optional per-spawn controls for suppress/internal/route-to-parent behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already left the most concrete maintainer-facing review and is tied to the key announce-delivery history.
